sub_sector.value: injectable, inhalation and nasal generic and proprietary drugs; biosimilars

healthcare_segment.detail: Biopharmaceutical developing, manufacturing and marketing injectable, intranasal and inhalation products, biologics and biosimilars.

product_stage.detail: Sells marketed products such as Baqsimi, iron sucrose, teriparatide pen and ipratropium inhaler.

customer_payer.detail: Hospitals and clinicians buy injectables; retail prescriptions such as Baqsimi paid by insurers, government programs and patients.

therapeutic_area.detail: Diverse portfolio: glucagon for low blood sugar, iron deficiency anemia in kidney disease, respiratory, emergency drugs.
